note: Known expo lint errors already on main. Each entry allows up to `count` distinct lines for that file and rule. Repeated messages on one line count once, so moving a finding to another line stays allowed. A further line, or any other file or rule, fails CI.

allow.reason: Copies the saved difficulty into local selection after economy storage loads. A render-time setState changes when the first paint shows the saved path.
Hides the last-chance menu when play leaves that phase, and shows it after the woods coach delay. That is session UI timing.
Animated.Values are stored with useRef().current and read while rendering motes, including the effect deps and the style object. The same line can be reported more than once.
expo-video looping is set by assigning player.loop. The immutability rule treats the useVideoPlayer result as frozen.
The latest volume and callbacks are written to refs during render so drag handlers are not one frame stale, and PanResponder is created from that handler.
